one.title: Shape your next story
one.intro: Give the idea you want to explore a name. Your first project is where its story begins.

two.title: Every story needs a beginning
two.intro: Create a project to capture a title, the first idea, and a cover. The rest can come later.

three.title: Save the idea that came first
three.intro: A project gives a place to the story that still lives only in your imagination. Start with what matters most.

four.title: A story is waiting here
four.intro: Choose a title and write a few words about your idea. A cover can help give it an identity.

one.title: Stories in the making
one.intro: Each project gives a story its own identity. Your ideas stay together here, ready to take new directions.

two.title: Your archive of ideas
two.intro: Your library holds the projects you have created. Search by title or description to find an idea.

three.title: Stories already begun
three.intro: Each project holds a name, a description, and a cover. See your ideas side by side and make room for the next one.

four.title: A world in the making
four.intro: Your ideas have an identity now. Use this library to find projects and remember where each story began.
